# AddPageOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Options for [`Document.addPage`](document.md#addpage).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`margin`](#margin): Page margin in points; defaults to the document's margin.
- [`margins`](#margins): Optional four-sided page margin.
- [`orientation`](#orientation): Page orientation.
- [`size`](#size): Page size; defaults to the document's configured page size.

### `margin`

```typescript
margin?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Page margin in points; defaults to the document's margin.

### `margins`

```typescript
margins?: ThicknessInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Optional four-sided page margin.

### `orientation`

```typescript
orientation?: PageOrientation | undefined
```

*optional*

Page orientation. When set, it is applied to `size` (or the document's page size). When omitted with no `size`, the document orientation applies.

### `size`

```typescript
size?: PdfSize | undefined
```

*optional*

Page size; defaults to the document's configured page size.
